verdict.rationale: The SDK is explicitly built on top of Claude Code and spawns/bundles a 'claude' CLI subprocess or native Claude Code binary (claude-agent-sdk-docs-20, claude-agent-sdk-docs-36, claude-agent-sdk-gh-1), and the only 'migration' story documented is migrating FROM other agent SDKs INTO this one (claude-agent-sdk-docs-33), not swapping the underlying model/provider within it. No evidence anywhere in the pack shows configuration for alternate LLM providers or model-agnostic abstraction; the product is architecturally coupled to Claude/Claude Code.
